idea-plugin.name: Local Secrets Tripwire
idea-plugin.description:
Local Secrets Tripwire — Real-Time Secret Detection for Your IDE

Leaked secrets are the #1 cause of security breaches. Local Secrets Tripwire scans your files in real time for API keys, tokens, passwords, and private keys — catching them before they are committed to version control. All scanning happens locally. Zero data leaves your machine.

Detection Engine

  • 14 built-in patterns for AWS keys, GitHub tokens, Slack tokens, Stripe keys, Google API keys, SendGrid keys, JWTs, private keys, connection strings, and more
  • Shannon entropy analysis for high-randomness strings (configurable threshold)
  • Custom regex patterns for organization-specific secrets
  • Runs as a standard IntelliJ code inspection in the Security group

Editor Integration

  • Inline warnings for lines containing potential secrets
  • Gutter icons for quick identification of secret locations
  • Hover tooltips showing secret type, severity, masked value, and entropy score
  • Masked display of detected values for safety

Configuration

  • Allowlist support via .secrets-allowlist file for false positive suppression
  • Configurable entropy threshold (default 4.5)
  • Custom pattern table with ID, name, regex, secret type, severity, and description
  • Team-shared settings via .secrets-tripwire.yaml (Pro)

Advanced Features (Pro)

  • Pre-commit guard to block commits containing secrets
  • Git history scan for previously leaked secrets
  • Hard blocking mode to prevent saving files with secrets
  • Unlimited custom detection patterns

Pricing

  • Free: 14 built-in patterns, entropy analysis, inline warnings, gutter icons, allowlist, up to 3 custom patterns
  • Pro ($2.90/month): Unlimited custom patterns, pre-commit guard, git history scan, hard blocking mode, team-shared configuration

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.3+ (or any JetBrains IDE based on IntelliJ Platform)
  • Java 17+
  • Git4Idea plugin (optional, for Git integration features)

Support

  • GitHub: github.com/JirakJ/local-secrets-tripwire
  • Issues: Report a Bug
  • Author: Jakub Jirák
idea-plugin.change-notes:
What's New

  • Real-Time Secret Scanning - Detects API keys, tokens, and passwords as you type with inline editor warnings
  • 14 Built-in Patterns - Recognizes AWS keys, GitHub tokens, Slack tokens, Stripe keys, JWTs, private keys, and more
  • Shannon Entropy Analysis - Identifies high-randomness strings that may be secrets using configurable thresholds
  • Gutter Warnings - Visual icons on lines containing potential secrets for quick identification
  • Allowlist Support - Suppress false positives with a .secrets-allowlist file in your project root
  • Custom Patterns - Add your own regex detection patterns for organization-specific secrets
  • Pre-Commit Guard - Optionally block commits that contain detected secrets
  • Git History Scan - Scan past commits to find previously leaked secrets in your repository
